page.overview:
Who is Celeste?

is a blue dragonborn mother of two, held in Rybad-Kol prison until the Strife Emperor's defeat near the end of the Calamity. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Celeste spent most of her time concerned about her children and in keeping them calm under extremely frightening conditions, although she herself was also terrified. She wore a peasant's gown with a shawl over her shoulders.

Celeste and her children were part of a caravan of dragonborn being assembled at the prison to be sent to the Scaled Tyrant, either to fight on the front lines or to be eaten by her. They happened to be seated next to Crokas and Erro Mordaurum, and when Rei'nia Saph arrived with a convincing story that Crokas was contagious, they were part of the group taken to the prison's oubliette in order to minimize the risk of illness being spread. Thus, they survived the battle between the Strife Emperor and the Prime Deities that took place above them, and were part of the group of twelve that began the trek northward in its aftermath.

During the journey Crokas continued carrying Celeste's children so that they wouldn't get tired, but the mother carried one of them on the last leg of the journey so that Crokas could carry Fiedra. When they reached the refugee center of Torm's Hill, Celeste was in terrible shape from the journey but told Crokas he was now family to them because of his aid carrying the children on the way. She then left to find some food, leaving Celwyn and Celdria with Coswald.
